The Largest AI & Software Development Conference on the Prairies!
Join us this September for the biggest Prairie Dev Con yet! We're expanding to six rooms of sessions over the two days and featuring over 40 world-class speakers delivering more than 70 sessions on all things software development and AI. Whether you're a developer, manager, or just passionate about tech, there's something for everyone at PrDC 2026!
Don't miss out on this opportunity to learn, connect, and grow with the Prairie Dev Con community!
Event Starts In:
Join Our Mailing List!

Keynote
Craig Shyjak, VP of Architecture, Laivly
Craig Shyjak is a technology executive and architecture leader focused on the future of software development. With 20+ years of experience and a strong entrepreneurial drive, he has built and led teams delivering scalable platforms across cloud, data, and AI ecosystems.

His recent work explores the rise of agentic AI and its implications for how software is built and consumed. From augmenting developers with AI-driven workflows to designing systems where agents act on behalf of users, Craig focuses on what this shift means for architecture, team structures, and the role of engineers.

He brings a practical, builder-oriented perspective grounded in real-world implementation, with a focus on turning emerging capabilities into production-ready systems.
